title: Walking Crops
description: Adds enemies inspired by Minecraft crops.
body:
![WKCR](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0361123f590702c00db402a051a60979b94b2773.png)


They are alive!



🦎 requires GeckoLib

🧩 Compatible with Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge)

Adds various hostile plant-based creatures to the world.
When defeated, they drop a new item used for new recipes.
It is recommended to install Jade to easily view the recipes and item info.

These creatures can be dangerous or annoying. I try to keep them balanced. 🦧



MOBS:

![potato](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1838ebb172a8a3db0acab41a676980e770255382.png)

POTATOES

Large potatoes; they have higher resistance and health, and are among the most common.


![beetroot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b80dbdb9ae805490273a28cdb18cf0e34a77d1c.png)

BEETROOTS

Beetroots with large foreheads that they won't hesitate to use as a weapon.


![carrot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0048d747c27589b88ee0ac137b96e13dee7d4339.png)

CARROTS

Fast-moving carrots that are hard to stop.


![berrie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0148a949679a0848373f2aa1e6cc2cce565a68be.png)

BERRIES

A family of berries; they can be annoying but aren't very common.


![hive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56d15412177437be97610e99e443e6e2ee73b1a7.png)

HIVE

A hive that splits apart to make your life miserable; they hate rainy days.


![watermelon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c4ff57209a7353f692ac249f422479b4c02ab0a.png)

WATERMELONS

Watermelons; they are more dangerous than they look.



🧠 More updates coming soon!
